data_quality.notes: Full name Dario Esteban Osorio Osorio, born 24 Jan 2004 in Hijuelas, Chile, per fotmob/CPFC.co.uk. Rose through Universidad de Chile academy, transferred to FC Midtjylland (31 Aug 2023, ~EUR 5m, contract to 2028); 121 apps/25 goals/18 assists across that spell. Joined Crystal Palace in 2026 on a season-long loan with an option to buy (per Yahoo Sports/CPFC.co.uk); current_club/league set to Crystal Palace/Premier League accordingly, with availability 'loan possible' reflecting the loan structure. 2025/26 stats (11 apps, 2G/3A) are his final Midtjylland Superliga form before the move; Premier League/Palace stats not yet available at as_of date.
